seoDescription: Find LCPS 2026–27 first days by grade, school breaks, remote-learning dates, last days, graduation times, and official English and Spanish calendar PDFs.
heroSummary: Las Cruces Public Schools begins 2026–27 with a transition day for kindergarten, sixth grade, and ninth grade on Friday, July 24, 2026. Grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–12 begin Monday, July 27. Fall Break is October 5–9, Winter Break is December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is March 15–19. K, 6, and 9 finish May 20; grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–11 finish May 21.
calendarNotes: LCPS does not have one first day or last day for every student. Kindergarten, grade 6, and grade 9 begin July 24 and finish May 20; most other non-senior grades begin July 27 and finish May 21. Seniors follow graduation and campus instructions. Educator Planning dates include remote learning activities, while August 28 and February 12 are no-school conference and planning dates. Cultural Awareness Week is an observance while school remains in session. APECHS and Early Childhood students have separate official calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: Are LCPS Educator Planning days days off?
calendarFaqs.a: Not ordinary days off. LCPS labels August 27, October 12, February 11, and March 29 as Educator Planning dates with remote learning activities.

calendarFaqs.q: Which calendar should APECHS students use?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the separate Arrowhead Park ECHS instructional calendar in English or Spanish, along with school communications for exact program dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Which calendar should LCPS Early Childhood families use?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the separate LCPS Early Childhood calendar in English or Spanish for Early Childhood, Head Start, and NM PreK dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for each LCPS grade group?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten, sixth grade, and ninth grade finish May 20. Grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–11 finish May 21. Seniors should follow their high school's graduation instructions.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 11, 2026, against the official LCPS calendar page and the one-page English instructional calendar revised July 27, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: The main calendar was checked visually because color coding and compact grade labels can be lost or flattened during text extraction.
The printed totals are 183 student days and 190 teacher days.
Both first and last instructional dates were recorded by grade group instead of collapsing the transition schedule into one districtwide date.
Educator Planning dates are listed as remote-learning days. August 28 and February 12 are listed separately as no-school days.
Cultural Awareness Week is listed as an in-session observance because the official calendar says school remains in session.
APECHS and Early Childhood calendars are linked separately and are not combined with the main K–12 date list.
The source PDF says it was approved by the LCPS Board on February 18, 2025, and revised July 27, 2026.
